sections.note: Holds only the option 2 row (5 frames, the 'on hover' label and the notification-types spec text). Its title card 14045:596900 sits just outside the section's left edge. Recorded under Ignored options per the standing rule; see doubt 1.

notes: Two rows sit directly on the page (no section), both at 30% layer opacity; the third row is inside 'Section 1' at full opacity, with its title card just outside the section's left edge.

Panel content spec (text 15460:173639, under 14553:287625) lists six notification types: 1 Project shared, 2 Chat shared, 3 Artifact shared (for review), 4 Mention in multiplayer (@), 5 Routine completion (run completed), 6 Artifact creation (created and shared with you). Applies to the Notifications panel whichever option is built.

The earlier HTML prototype prototypes/notification-flow (built 2026-10-07 from Section 1) used 14761:289991 as a 'What's New tab' step; that node no longer exists. Section 1 now ends with 15460:171060 (expanded rail + Notification Panel). The panel-pair group 14761:43871 used by prototypes/notification-panels is also gone.

doubts.q: Here the standing 'Option 1 only' rule and the 'dimmed = parked' rule collide: option 1 (panel opens straight from the rail, page level) is at 30% opacity, while option 2 (account menu with a Notifications row, Section 1) is full opacity, newer (14553/15460 ids), already prototyped in prototypes/notification-flow, and matches the AccountMenu the Chat + Artifacts shell uses. Should this page follow option 2 instead?
doubts.proposedDefault: Mapped per the standing rule: option 1 (flagged dimmed) is the journey and option 2 is listed in full under ignoredOptions. If you say 'option 2 here', swapping is a one-line change (move the ignoredOptions entry into journeys).
